1.title: Overview
1.content: At SynthetIQ Partners, we strive to ensure your complete satisfaction with our services. This refund policy outlines the terms and conditions for requesting and receiving refunds for our services.

2.title: Eligibility for Refunds
2.content: Refund requests are evaluated on a case-by-case basis. You may be eligible for a refund if: (1) The service was not delivered as described, (2) Technical issues prevented service delivery, or (3) You cancel within the specified cancellation period for your service plan.

3.title: Refund Process
3.content: To request a refund, please contact our support team with your order details and reason for the refund request. We will review your request and respond within 2-3 business days. If approved, refunds are typically processed within 5-7 business days.

4.title: Non-Refundable Items
4.content: Certain services and fees are non-refundable, including but not limited to: (1) Setup fees, (2) Custom development work that has been delivered, (3) Services used or consumed, and (4) Cancellations after the specified refund period.

5.title: Contact Us
5.content: If you have any questions about our refund policy or would like to request a refund, please contact our support team at support@synthetiqpartners.com.
